notes:
Full investigation via direct HTTP + Playwright (client-rendered React/SPA site). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (Allow: / for AhrefsBot/AhrefsSiteAudit, generic Disallow only for /order, /account, /cart, /checkout). Pulled sitemap.xml -> sitemap-header.xml (mirrors the site's full mega-menu/header nav taxonomy), sitemap-footer.xml, and sitemap-products.xml (898 total product URLs, entire catalog). Extracted every unique category_shop breadcrumb value from sitemap-header.xml (the complete nav taxonomy: Apparel > Jewellery/Saanjh/Sustain Woman(+subs); Gifting > Shop By Occasion (Anniversary, Birthday, New Home, Wedding, Newly-Weds, Gifts-Of-Gratitude, Seasonal-Gifts) and Shop By Recipient (Friends like Family, Holiday Gifting/Wellness-Enthusiast combo, India Lovers/Indophiles combo, Little Ones, The Gracious Host); Home > Ancient Rituals, Bath & Fragrance, Cushion Covers, Decor, Dining, Drinkware & Bar, Home Textiles, Kids (+ all subs)). None of these categories is named after a specific festival/holiday (Diwali, Christmas, Holi, Raksha Bandhan, Eid, New Year, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Easter, Mother's/Father's Day) anywhere in the site's own nav taxonomy.

Specifically checked the two candidates that looked seasonal-adjacent: (1) 'Seasonal-Gifts' filter under Gifting > Shop By Occasion (rendered via Playwright: 30 of 79 products in that PLP) - product list sampled (Uzaira Vase, Argent Aperitif Jug, tea sets, aromatherapy gift sets, candles, a diya set) is generic decor/tableware/gifting merchandise with no festival-specific naming or curation; the label 'Seasonal' does not name any specific holiday, so it fails the 'website associates it with a SPECIFIC holiday' test and was excluded. (2) 'Holiday Gifting' - appears only as a stale/orphaned sitemap URL combined via pipe-OR with 'Wellness-Enthusiast' (category_shop=...Holiday+Gifting|...Wellness-Enthusiast); it is NOT present in the live SHOP BY RECIPIENT facet list rendered on the actual PLP (only 5 facets show: The Gracious Host, Indophiles, Friends Like Family, Wellness-Enthusiast, Little Ones) - unreachable as a clean standalone facet through real site navigation, so excluded as not genuine current taxonomy.

Probed guessed holiday-slug URLs (/diwali, /christmas, /festive, /festival, /holi, /raksha-bandhan, /new-year, /collection/diwali, /gifting/diwali) - all returned HTTP 200, but comparison against a deliberately nonsense slug (/zzzznonsense12345) showed an IDENTICAL generic homepage <title> for every guess, confirming this is a client-side catch-all SPA route returning 200 for any path, not real category pages - correctly disregarded per the hard rule on suspiciously perfect/numerous holiday URLs.

Ran internal site search (https://www.goodearth.in/search?q=diwali, the correct query param verified against a decoy param 'query=' which ignored filtering and returned near-total-catalog 881/898 results) - 'q=diwali' returned 54 fuzzy/semantic matches (diyas, votives, plates, vases, katoris) scattered across Dining/Decor/Gifting; this is a search-relevance result set, not a merchandised PLP category, and per the rules a search result page is not itself a valid seasonal category (also zero-result/present search is not proof either way - used only as a supplementary check, not primary evidence).

Checked the GIFTING mega-menu landing page (/category_landing/gifting_373/) - renders with no populated content/links beyond header/footer boilerplate (broken/empty CMS banner state), so it could not reveal additional festival tiles. Checked Our World > Design Philosophy > Collections page for named product 'collections' (Bosporus, Eternal Kashi, Farah Baksh, Gandhara, Maladvipa, Ratnakara, Samarqand, Shambala, Tangier) - these are artistic/geographic design-collection names, not holidays. Checked corporate-gifts-catalogue page - it is a brochure/PDF-style page with no indexed festive category content, and even if populated would be a catalogue/brochure page, not a genuine PLP. Checked homepage banner/hero content and blog stories - the only holiday-adjacent hit was a single 'Eid' mention, which is a lifestyle blog story link (/our-world/stories/be-my-guest-eid-style-adil-ahmed/), not a shoppable PLP category, so excluded (blog/editorial content is explicitly out of scope).

Conclusion: as of 2026-09-04, Good Earth's live taxonomy contains no genuine holiday/festival-specific PLP category (Diwali included, despite being a premium Indian brand where Diwali collections would be expected - it is plausible the site has not yet launched its 2026 Diwali collection this early in September, roughly 9 weeks before Diwali; this reflects the site's current state only). No Mother's Day / Father's Day category exists either (only generic Birthday/Anniversary/Wedding/New-Home/Gifts-of-Gratitude occasion tags). Rows left empty as required for a genuine no_seasonal outcome.
